title: Eventual equality for descended scalar sections
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : Iᵒᵖ → Scheme a system of qcqs schemes with affine transitions and limit cone c. Let F_i be abelian etale sheaves with compatible inverse-image transition maps φ (identity and composition laws), let G_i be their inverse images on c.pt with the prescribed comparison isomorphisms eG and transition maps, and let L be a colimit cocone of G. Fix i₀ and a qcqs etale object T₀ over D(i₀). On J = {j | i₀ ≤ j}, let Tj and Tlim be its base changes. Choose pullback-pasting isomorphisms γ and δ satisfying the first-projection equations. Define ρ by the inverse-image adjunction unit followed by φ and restriction along γ inverse, and μ by the projection unit followed by eG inverse, the L leg and restriction along δ inverse, exactly as in the Lean statement. For every j and sections s,t of F_j on Tj, μ_j(s)=μ_j(t) implies that some k in J and arrow a:j→k satisfy ρ_a(s)=ρ_a(t). The notions are those of def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves and def-pc-fibre-product.

source.place: Sites Tag 09YN, lemma-colimit; Etale Cohomology Tag 09YQ, degree-zero comparison.

proof.text: Restrict to the directed tail above i₀ and choose a finite affine cover of the qcqs etale object T₀. On each affine member, the affine etale site colimit and the sheaf section comparison identify equal limit images with equal representatives in a filtered colimit of stage sections. Filtered-colimit equality gives a common later stage; directedness combines the finitely many witnesses, and separatedness of the stage sheaf gives equality on T₀. The prescribed unit and projection equations identify these maps with ρ and μ.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_limit_scalar_sections_eventual_equality
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    (i₀ : I) (T₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale)
    [CompactSpace T₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T₀.left] :
    let J := {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}
    let Tj := fun j : J ↦
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
        (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)).obj T₀
    let Tlim := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj T₀
    ∀ (γ : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
          (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj j) ≅ Tj k)
      (δ : ∀ j : J,
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j) ≅ Tlim),
      (∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
        (γ j k a).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE k.property).op) =
          pullback.fst (Tj j).hom (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op) ≫
            pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) →
      (∀ j : J,
        (δ j).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst T₀.hom (c.π.app (op i₀)) =
          pullback.fst (Tj j).hom (c.π.app (op j.val)) ≫
            pullback.fst T₀.hom (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)) →
    let ρ := fun (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) ↦
      ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app (op (Tj j)) ≫
        (φ (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a)).hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (D.map (show j.val ⟶ k.val from a).op)).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        (F k.val).obj.map (γ j k a).inv.op
    let μ := fun j : J ↦
      ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (c.π.app (op j.val))).unit.app (F j.val)).hom.app (op (Tj j)) ≫
        (eG j.val).inv.hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        (L.ι.app j.val).hom.app
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤
            (c.π.app (op j.val))).obj (Tj j))) ≫
        L.pt.obj.map (δ j).inv.op
    ∀ (j : J) (s t : (F j.val).obj.obj (op (Tj j))), μ j s = μ j t →
      ∃ (k : J) (a : j ⟶ k), ρ j k a s = ρ j k a t
